description: Companies with a given event in the last 7 days (or an earlier ISO week): guidance raised or cut, unplanned insider buying, executive changes, acquisitions, buybacks, layoffs. Each row quotes the filing or call.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; use `next` from the previous page

snapshot.description: Snapshot from the first page; detects changed lists

week.description: Optional ISO week such as 2026-w44; omit for the last 7 days
